resumeText:
Karthik Raman | Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu | karthik.raman.iot@example.com

EDUCATION
B.E., Electronics and Communication Engineering, Noyyal College of Technology, Coimbatore (2022 - 2026) | CGPA 8.0/10

INTERNSHIP
IoT Intern, Noyyal Smart Systems, Coimbatore (May 2025 - Jul 2025, 10 weeks)
- Wrote Embedded C firmware for an ESP32 board that reads temperature and humidity sensors in a textile mill.
- Published sensor readings over MQTT to a Mosquitto broker every 30 seconds.
- Helped connect the devices to AWS IoT Core and checked incoming messages in the console.

PROJECTS
- Smart irrigation (final-year project): Built a LoRa-based soil moisture network with three field nodes and one gateway for a farm near Pollachi.
- BLE attendance tag (academic, Wireless Communication course): Built a Bluetooth Low Energy beacon on an nRF52 board and logged nearby phones as part of the Wireless Communication course.
- Home energy monitor (personal): Measured plug load current with an ACS712 sensor and Arduino and plotted it on a web page.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- Coursework: Microcontrollers and Embedded Systems, Wireless Communication, Computer Networks, Digital Electronics
- NPTEL: Introduction to Internet of Things (Elite)

SKILLS
Embedded C, Arduino, ESP32, MQTT, LoRa, BLE, AWS IoT Core, TCP/IP basics, Python basics, KiCad basics

ACTIVITIES
- IEEE student branch, organised an IoT workshop
- College robotics team, Robocon 2024
